question: What is the true nature and supreme reality of the Mothers and powers?
premises: True nature, being, and attainment are measured in relation to the Mothers.
This applies to the world-generating powers.
Their supreme reality is nothing but freedom.
inference: The ontological status of the Mothers and powers is grounded in their supreme reality, which is sheer autonomy.
uncertainties: meyo@nayā is read as 'by this measure/criterion' in a compressed doctrinal sense.
plain_english: True nature, being, and attainment among the Mothers are to be understood in this way; in those world-generating powers, the supreme reality is indeed freedom alone.
